x_in, y_in, max_b = map(int, input().split())
min_diff = float('inf')
best_b, best_a = 1, 0

def update_if_better(b, a):
    global min_diff, best_b, best_a
    diff = abs((a / b) - (x_in / y_in))
    if diff + 1e-15 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff
        best_b, best_a = b, a

for b in range(1, max_b + 1):
    a_floor = (x_in * b) // y_in
    a_ceil = a_floor + 1
    update_if_better(b, a_floor)
    update_if_better(b, a_ceil)

print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")
